scope: 24 deterministic shortlisted ROCO source-training articles only; article licensing/provenance evidence, no legal or model-use approval
normalization: XML parser resolves entities; concatenate caption itertext in document order; NFC Unicode normalization; collapse Unicode whitespace runs to one ASCII space; strip outer whitespace; preserve case, punctuation, hyphens, spelling and words. No label stripping, fuzzy matching, token reordering or medical interpretation.
